The name might give you a clue—it’s named after the rich, sweet dessert, and that’s exactly what you’re getting. The strain has a creamy, dessert-like flavor with hints of vanilla and a touch of earthy spice. It’s smooth and sweet, making each toke feel like a treat. As for the effects, Tres Leches offers a balanced high. It starts with a nice, euphoric uplift that can get you feeling chatty and happy, which is great for hanging out with friends or just enjoying some good vibes. As the high progresses, it transitions into a more relaxed, mellow feeling. It’s not going to leave you glued to the couch, but it will definitely help you unwind and kick back. In terms of its therapeutic effects, Tres Leches can be great for managing stress or anxiety. It can help with relaxation without completely knocking you out, so you can still stay productive if you need to. It also tends to spark up an appetite, so if you’ve got the munchies, this strain’s got you covered. Overall, Tres Leches is a solid pick if you’re looking for a flavorful strain with a balanced high that’s both uplifting and relaxing.
